name: Era
subtitle: Private-first offline music library
description: Official AltStore source for Era, an offline music library for iPhone and iPad.

apps.name: Era
apps.subtitle: Your music, organized your way.
apps.localizedDescription: A private-first offline library for released tracks, unreleased songs, demos, alternate versions, and personal audio files.

versions.localizedDescription:
Player controls now stay anchored to the bottom of the Now Playing screen, matching the Apple Music layout while keeping artwork and metadata at the top.
Built and visually verified on the newest available iPhone simulator with a long title. Includes the unsigned IPA, macOS Catalyst DMG/ZIP, and the verified player screenshot.

versions.localizedDescription:
27.0.2 Beta 1
- Fixes the Now Playing layout on current iPhone sizes: bounded artwork, stable title truncation, and compact grouped controls.
- Makes Listening Stats rankings deterministic when tracks or artists have equal play counts.
- Tested in the latest iPhone simulator with a long title and the import pipeline.

versions.localizedDescription:
Beta 1
- Removes the description text that sat under the Collections title.
- Store reset on schema conflicts no longer deletes the library silently: the database is backed up first, and the app tells you if a reset happened. Audio files stay in Files and can be re-imported.
Requires iOS 18 or later. Builds are unsigned.

versions.localizedDescription:
Beta 1
- Adds the official Era AltStore source with automatic release updates.
- Keeps direct IPA downloads and adds an AltDirect source button in the update drawer.
- Fixes the Collections header so the title, description, and sections stay correctly aligned on iPhone.
- Resets the public beta line to 27.0.0.
Requires iOS 18 or later. Builds are unsigned.
